policy: Frontend never reconstructs missing backend truth. Required unmapped semantics are blocking backend gaps.

gaps.requested_semantic: canonical producer-owned visual registry without V1 dependency
gaps.frontend_behavior: consume RHI_VISUAL_ASSET_REGISTRY_V2 only; fail closed when unavailable

gaps.requested_semantic: canonical D0/D1 item and aggregate planning truth including planned today, still to plan and reconciled totals
gaps.frontend_behavior: render only published planning truth; unknown or incomplete totals remain unavailable

gaps.surface: settings, automation mode and strategy profiles
gaps.requested_semantic: configured intent, executable write metadata, authoritative readback, effective policy and persistence
gaps.frontend_behavior: show only canonical writable controls; never synthesize write routes or optimistic success

gaps.surface: managed flexible loads and charging plan
gaps.requested_semantic: coherent actual/requested/planned power, producer command capability, plan eligibility and physical relationship truth
gaps.frontend_behavior: exclude infrastructure-only rows from managed planning and fail closed when eligibility evidence is incomplete

gaps.requested_semantic: canonical per-asset period energy and attribution for flexible/managed consumers
gaps.frontend_behavior: do not derive period energy from current power or buckets; show unavailable until published
